name: Sula Vineyards Limited
summary: Sula Vineyards Limited, founded in 1996 and headquartered in Mumbai, produces, buys and sells wine and spirits in India and overseas. Its range includes white, red, rosé and sparkling wines, and spirits under brands such as RASA, Dindori and York. It also runs wine tourism venues, including vineyard resorts, tasting rooms and restaurants.
